items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Einspruch gegen diesen Bußgeldbescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach seiner Zustellung einlegen.
items.computation: This is a formally served letter (Postzustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO, page 2 endorsed 'Zugestellt' 08.11.2025), so no deemed-delivery fiction applies; the two-week Einspruch period of § 67 Abs. 1 OWiG runs from the actual service date shown, Sat 08.11.2025. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of service is not counted, so counting starts Sun 09.11.2025; two weeks later (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB) is Sat 22.11.2025. Since Saturdays count as non-working for this purpose (§ 43 StPO with § 46 Abs. 1 OWiG), the deadline shifts to the next working day, Mon 24.11.2025.

items.title: Pay the fine, fee and delivery costs (total) once the decision is final
items.quote: Sobald der Bescheid rechtskräftig ist, haben Sie für die Zahlung des Gesamtbetrags zwei Wochen Zeit; geben Sie als Verwendungszweck bitte das Aktenzeichen an.
items.computation: Payment is due two weeks after the Bescheid becomes rechtskräftig (final). Assuming no Einspruch is filed, it becomes final the day after the Einspruch period expires, i.e. from Tue 25.11.2025 (the day after the Einspruch deadline of Mon 24.11.2025). Counting the two-week payment period the same way (day of the triggering event, 24.11.2025, not counted; §187 BGB), two weeks later is Mon 08.12.2025, which is a working day, so it stands. This date is contingent on the decision actually becoming final on that day (no Einspruch filed); if an Einspruch is filed the payment obligation and its deadline no longer apply as stated.

warnings: The payment due date (08.12.2025) assumes the Bescheid becomes final because no Einspruch is filed by 24.11.2025; filing an Einspruch would stop this payment obligation and start a different (court) procedure instead.

The Zustellungsurkunde on page 2 shows service on 08.11.2025, three days after the letter's own printed date (05.11.2025); the Einspruch deadline was computed from the later, actual service date as that is what a formal Postzustellungsurkunde controls.
